subject: Trial sweetener authorization and journalization plan
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.k@blueharbor.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@blueharbor.com>, BlueHarbor Billing <billing@blueharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: supplemental credits for delayed ingest

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the onboarding session last week. We started ingesting data into the sandbox but had a blocker with S3 permissions that cost us 3 full days of usage. We are close to the end of our 30-day pilot and will likely exceed the original stipend because of the lost time.

Would Redwood consider a small top-up to the pilot credits (roughly +$4,000 USD) or a 7-day extension so we can complete the eval without skewing the results? Our procurement team will need documentation of the accounting treatment for any credit or extension.

Attached is a usage snapshot for June. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Klein
Head of Data Platform
BlueHarbor Systems

Attachment: usage-report-Jun2028.csv (CSV)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.k@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@blueharbor.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: supplemental credits for delayed ingest

Hi Sara — appreciate the heads up and the usage snapshot. I'm sorry you hit that permissions snag.

We can do one of two things:
1) Issue a one-time promo credit (credit memo) for $4,000 that offsets the June invoice, or
2) Add a 7-calendar-day trial extension (no immediate invoice change) and reserve the promo credit for bookkeeping if you still exceed the stipend at final reconciliation.

I'll loop in Marcus from Finance to confirm the accounting path and Neha for operational steps (Jira/HubSpot). From a commercial view I'm fine with either; want to make sure your procurement team gets the right docs.

Would you prefer the credit memo today or the extension? If credit, we'll prepare a credit memo and share the journal entry guidance.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[signature]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask: supplemental credits for delayed ingest

Grace / Neha — thanks for the context. A few accounting notes: 

- If we issue a credit memo for $4,000 to offset an existing June invoice, the recommended treatment is to post it as a contra-revenue (credit to revenue; debit to accounts receivable) and tag the memo as a "promotional allowance" with the deal_id DL-4589. This keeps revenue recognition clean and lets RevOps track promo usage.
- If instead we do a 7-day extension only, there is no journal entry now; we should create a suspense account entry for the reserved promo (liability placeholder) in case it's converted later.
- For customer procurement/audit, we'll provide a short cover note explaining the rationale and the relevant GLA mapping. I suggest GLA: 4001 (Subscription Revenue) with contra-revenue subaccount 4098 (Promotional Allowances) — subject to external tax counsel if material.

Neha: can RevOps generate the HubSpot credit note and a PDF cover memo? Karthik: can you confirm if we need additional approvals for promo > $2,500 under the current discount matrix?

-Marcus
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-cover-memo.docx (referenced)

Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask: supplemental credits for delayed ingest

Thanks Marcus — I'll create the HubSpot credit note and the customer-facing PDF that outlines the accounting treatment and reference DL-4589.

Karthik: FYI on approval matrix: promos between $2,500 and $5,000 need sales manager + finance signoff. Grace, do you want me to route the credit for signatures or start with the extension and keep the reserved promo in Suspense? 

Grace: I'll draft both assets (credit memo PDF and the extension confirmation). If you choose the credit now I'll route for signatures today; if extension we'll send a 7-day addendum and hold the reserved promo in our ledger.

-Neha

Redwood Inference

Sara — thanks for the quick decision on the call this morning. Per your preference, we will issue a $4,000 credit memo to offset the June invoice and provide a one-week extension on the sandbox window to account for lost time.

What we'll send you today:
- Official credit memo PDF (credit memo #RM-2028-271) indicating contra-revenue treatment and reference DL-4589, for your AP team to apply to the June invoice.
- Short cover memo explaining accounting treatment and GLA mapping (4001/4098).
- Confirmed one-week extension email and the updated pilot end date: 2028-07-11.

Marcus/Neha: please route RM-2028-271 through the approval flow (sales manager + finance) and attach the signed cover memo to HubSpot. Sara, expect the DocuSign link for the approval routing if needed; otherwise we'll deliver the PDF directly to billing@blueharbor.com.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
